resources.string: Set a 4 to 8 digit PIN. Enter your PIN and press = on the calculator anytime to open your private vault.
Tip: Long-press AC on the calculator anytime if you forget your PIN.
Keeps selected app lock monitoring active in the background.

Hide Calculator X operates 100%% offline on your device.

1. Zero Server Uploads: Your photos, videos, PINs, and recovery keys never leave your device.

2. Hardware-Backed Encryption: Private media is encrypted using AES-256-GCM with keys stored inside the Android Keystore.

3. Minimal Permissions: Media importing uses the zero-permission Android Photo Picker. App Locker permissions (Usage Access and Display Over Other Apps) are used strictly on-device to detect and lock selected apps.

4. No Telemetry or Ads: We collect no analytics, identifiers, or personal information.
